# NiceSalt

NiceSalt designs and builds AI products, web apps, and publishing platforms with deep data expertise. From vibes to viability: two decades of product and data experience guide what to build, what to measure, and what to improve. The studio is led by David Berzin (https://davidberzin.com).

## What we build

- AI products: assistants and agents wired into real data, with a person in the loop where the stakes are high.
- Web apps: customer portals, internal tools, and the workflows that connect them.
- Publishing platforms: sites and newsletters where one article becomes a page, an email, and a new subscriber.

## How to start

- Free teardown: share a site, product, or prototype for a focused review. A few requests are selected, with timing confirmed before work begins. Request at https://www.nicesalt.com/free-teardown/.
- Product builds: most work begins as a focused first version with a fixed scope, then grows from there.

## Selected work

- RobinBerzinMD.com (https://www.nicesalt.com/case-studies/robinberzinmd/): a publishing platform that turns one article into a website update, newsletter, and social assets, with editorial review before release.
- Bibo (https://www.nicesalt.com/case-studies/bibo/): an independent AI audiobook concept demo using pre-generated listening experiences.
- ExplorerHealth.co (https://www.nicesalt.com/case-studies/explorer-health/): a self-initiated health product exploration. The assessment concept is not clinically validated and does not establish care availability.

## Notes

- A working demo beats a deck (https://www.nicesalt.com/notes/a-working-demo-beats-a-deck/): why an AI audiobook concept was built as a demo.
- Production got cheap. Judgment didn't. (https://www.nicesalt.com/notes/production-got-cheap-judgment-didnt/): product judgment matters even as making software gets faster.
- Why expert sites undersell the expert (https://www.nicesalt.com/notes/why-expert-sites-undersell-the-expert/): structural reasons expert websites can read weaker than the people behind them.
